entities.name: Bojuka Bay
entities.description: Swampy mangrove bay on Bala Ged, mouth of the Umung River, home to marsh trolls and Grotag goblins.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Continent on Zendikar overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire that Bojuka once belonged to.

entities.name: Obuun
entities.description: Pre-spirit elf who led the elven revolt.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose release destroyed Bala Ged.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker whose use of the Lithoform Core began healing the continent.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: Source of healing power used by Nissa.

events.summary: Elven nations revolt against their kor rulers and topple their Skyclave.
events.quote: revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave

events.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release the entire continent of Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
events.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed

events.summary: Nissa Revane's use of the Lithoform Core starts the bay and continent recovering.
events.quote: the bay and the rest of the continent slowly started to recover
